highlights:

# FX Audit API

The forensic FX audit engine that powers iPayX. Detect hidden bank spreads vs mid-market benchmark on any currency transaction. Bearer auth, OpenAPI 3.1, signed webhooks.

Get an API key  OpenAPI Spec

3 endpoints

audit · rates · audit/document

Signed webhooks

HMAC-SHA256 · audit.completed

Marketplace ready

Zapier · n8n · MCP

## Authentication

Every request requires a Bearer token in the `Authorization` header. Keys start with `ipx_live_`.

HTTP

```
Authorization: Bearer ipx_live_xxxxxxxxxxxx

```

## Base URL

URL

```
https://hvujzsdwcoweirroubeh.supabase.co/functions/v1/fx-public-api-v1

```

POST

## /audit

Run a forensic audit on a single transaction. Returns a 0–10 score, hidden spread vs mid-market, and estimated loss.

cURLJavaScriptPython

bash

```
curl -X POST https://hvujzsdwcoweirroubeh.supabase.co/functions/v1/fx-public-api-v1/audit \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ipx_live_YOUR_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "amount": 50000,
    "currency_from": "USD",
    "currency_to": "EUR",
    "bank_rate": 0.91
  }'

```

json

POST

## /audit/document

Audit a batch of parsed transactions (e.g. exported from QuickBooks, Xero, Sage, or your CSV). Returns weighted-average spread and per-row breakdown.

bash

```
curl -X POST https://hvujzsdwcoweirroubeh.supabase.co/functions/v1/fx-public-api-v1/audit/document \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ipx_live_YOUR_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "rows": [
      {
        "date": "2026-04-15",
        "sourceCurrency": "USD",
        "targetCurrency": "EUR",
        "amountSource": 10000,
        "amountTarget": 9050
      }
    ]
  }'

```

## Webhooks

Subscribe to `audit.completed` events to power Zapier triggers, n8n workflows, or your own Slack alerts. Every payload is signed with HMAC-SHA256.

### Verifying signatures (Node.js)

javascript

```
import crypto from "node:crypto";

function verifySignature(rawBody, signature, secret) {
  const expected = "sha256=" + crypto
    .createHmac("sha256", secret)
    .update(rawBody)
    .digest("hex");
  return crypto.timingSafeEqual(
    Buffer.from(signature),
    Buffer.from(expected),
  );
}

// In your Express/Next.js handler:
app.post("/webhook", express.raw({ type: "application/json" }), (req, res) => {
  const sig = req.headers["x-ipayx-signature"];
  if (!verifySignature(req.body, sig, process.env.IPAYX_WEBHOOK_SECRET)) {
    return res.status(401).send("invalid signature");
  }
  const event = JSON.parse(req.body);
  console.log("Audit completed:", event.data);
  res.status(200).send("ok");
});

```

auth.title: Security & trust
highlights:
## Server-side credential handling

Third-party API keys, and payment secrets never leave our secure backend functions. No secret is ever exposed to the browser.

## Postgres Row-Level Security (RLS)

All sensitive tables (audits, transactions, profiles, API keys) are protected by strict RLS policies. A user can only access their own data — isolation is enforced by the database itself.

...

## Secure API key hashing

Issued API keys are hashed with SHA-256 before storage. Only the prefix is kept in cleartext for identification — the raw key is never recoverable, even by our team.

# iPayX Protocol — API Terms of Service

Version 0.1 (Draft)

Last updated: 2026-11-23

## 1. Definitions

"iPayX" refers to iPayX Protocol, operated by 11850091 Canada Inc. "API Client" means any entity that has been issued an API key (prefixed `ipx_live_`) to access the iPayX Audit API. "Client Data" means the raw transaction data submitted to the API. "Aggregated Data" means anonymized, statistical data derived from multiple API Clients.

## 2. License & API Access

Subject to these Terms and timely payment of fees, iPayX grants the API Client a non-exclusive, non-transferable, revocable license to access the API solely for the API Client's internal business purposes and for providing audit results to its own end customers.

## 3. Acceptable Use

API Clients agree not to:

- Reverse-engineer, decompile, or attempt to extract the iPayX scoring algorithm.
- Submit fraudulent, fabricated, or illegally obtained transaction data.
- Use the API to harm, deceive, or mislead end customers.
- Exceed published rate limits or attempt to circumvent quota controls.

## 4. Fees & Billing

Subscription fees and per-audit overage charges are billed monthly via Stripe and follow the published pricing tiers (Starter, Growth, Enterprise). Overage usage beyond the included monthly quota is billed at the per-audit rate disclosed at time of subscription. Fees are non-refundable except as required by law.

## 5. Data Ownership & Aggregation Rights

5.1 Client Data. All raw transaction data submitted via the API remains the property of the submitting API Client.

5.2 Aggregated Benchmarks. iPayX retains the right to aggregate, anonymize, and use all transaction data processed through the API to create industry benchmarks, market reports, and statistical analyses. No individually identifiable client data will be disclosed — all benchmarks use anonymized buckets (e.g., volume ranges $1M–$ 5M, spread ranges 0–1%).

5.3 Restrictions on API Clients. API Clients may NOT:

- Resell, redistribute, or sublicense iPayX benchmark data, FX scores, or audit results to third parties.
- Use iPayX data to build competing benchmark products.
- Store iPayX audit results beyond 90 days without an active subscription.

5.4 Data Retention. iPayX retains anonymized aggregate data indefinitely. Raw client data is retained for 24 months from submission date, after which it is anonymized or deleted per client request.

...

## 9. Termination

Either party may terminate this agreement for material breach upon thirty (30) days written notice if the breach is not cured. iPayX may suspend or revoke an API key immediately for fraud, abuse, or violation of Section 3 (Acceptable Use). Upon termination, the API Client must cease all use of iPayX data and delete cached audit results within 30 days.

## README

# iPayX FX Audit MCP

**Expose hidden bank FX fees in 30 seconds. No signup required.**

The world's first Model Context Protocol server for foreign exchange forensic auditing. Any AI agent (Claude, Perplexity, Cursor, Copilot) can audit FX transactions against mid-market rates in real time and generate FINTRAC-certified forensic reports.

[!Smithery](https://smithery.ai/server/@ybolduc/ipayx-fx-auditor)
[!MCP Registry](https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io)

**Live endpoint (Cloudflare):** `https://wild-bird-a412.ybolduc.workers.dev/mcp`

---

## Tools

### `check_fx_rate`
Get the current mid-market exchange rate for any currency pair.

**Parameters:**
- `from_currency` (string) - Source currency code (e.g. `CAD`)
- `to_currency` (string) - Target currency code (e.g. `USD`)

**Auth:** None | **Cost:** Free forever

**Example:**
```json
{ "from_currency": "CAD", "to_currency": "USD" }
```

---

### `audit_transaction`
Audit a specific FX transaction. Compares the rate your bank applied against the real mid-market rate. Returns the hidden spread in basis points, a forensic score 1-10, and the total amount lost to hidden fees.

**Parameters:**
- `amount` (number) - Transaction amount
- `from_currency` (string) - Source currency code
- `to_currency` (string) - Target currency code
- `bank_rate` (number) - The rate your bank applied

**Auth:** None | **Cost:** 3 free/month per IP

**Example:**
```json
{
  "amount": 50000,
  "from_currency": "CAD",
  "to_currency": "USD",
  "bank_rate": 0.685,
  "bank_name": "TD Bank"
}
```

---

### `full_forensic_report`
Generate a complete forensic FX audit report suitable for legal proceedings, CFO review, or FINTRAC compliance documentation. Includes spread history, narrative analysis, and certified audit trail.

**Parameters:**
- `audit_id` (string) - ID from a previous `audit_transaction` call

**Auth:** Bearer token (API key required) | **Cost:** Per report

---

### `compare_fx_sources`
Compare FX rates from multiple sources simultaneously (Twelve Data, Open Exchange Rates). Detects discrepancies and identifies the most favorable rate. Essential for multi-bank or multi-broker comparisons.

**Parameters:**
- `from_currency` (string) - Source currency code
- `to_currency` (string) - Target currency code

**Auth:** None | **Cost:** Free

**Example:**
```json
{ "from_currency": "USD", "to_currency": "CAD" }
```

---

## Quick Start

### Claude Desktop
Add to your `claude_desktop_config.json`:
```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "ipayx-fx": {
      "url": "https://wild-bird-a412.ybolduc.workers.dev/mcp"
    }
  }
}
```

### Cursor / Windsurf
```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "ipayx-fx": {
      "url": "https://wild-bird-a412.ybolduc.workers.dev/mcp",
      "transport": "streamable-http"
    }
  }
}
```

### Perplexity
Settings → MCP Connectors → Add Remote → paste URL:
```
https://wild-bird-a412.ybolduc.workers.dev/mcp
```

### Smithery CLI
```bash
npx -y smithery skill add ybolduc/ipayx-fx-auditor
```

---

## Score Interpretation

| Score | Meaning | Action |
|-------|---------|--------|
| 8-10 | Fair rate | No action needed |
| 5-7 | Moderate markup | Negotiate with bank |
| 1-4 | Excessive hidden fees | Request forensic report |

---

## Compliance

- **FINTRAC MSB Certified:** C10001283
- **Jurisdiction:** Canada (FINTRAC applies to CA operations only)
- **FX Data Sources:** Twelve Data (primary) → Open Exchange Rates (fallback)
- **Weekend/Holiday Logic:** Cached Friday close rate with explicit `source: cached_friday_close` flag

---

## About iPayX Protocol

iPayX Protocol (11850091 Canada Inc.) is the only rail-agnostic FX forensic audit layer for B2B payments. We audit hidden costs regardless of payment rail - SWIFT, SEPA, Stablecoin, or Card.

**Website:** ipayx.ai | **Dashboard:** app.ipayx.ai
